title: Virtual threads in Java 21
statement: Which statement about virtual threads in Java 21 is true?
choices: They make CPU-bound computations faster than platform threads, because switching between them is cheaper.
They should be kept in a fixed-size pool and reused, because creating one is as costly as creating a platform thread.
When a virtual thread blocks inside a synchronized block, it stays pinned to its carrier platform thread instead of releasing it.
